card.name: Endings of long medical nouns
card.fires_on: The final piece of a long medical noun that is split into parts, such as the end of overdosage, embolism, carcinogenicity or redness. It fires on the part that completes the word, in label section headings and warnings.

card.writes: It adds word-ending pieces such as -ness, -ly and -ity, which suggests it helps finish a noun or adverb.
card.plain: It lights up on the last chunk of a long medical term, like the 'age' in overdosage, when the word is finished.
